shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|VALIDATED_BY|spec:\" src | head -80 && rg -n \"onError\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '260,430p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" --glob '*.test.ts' . | head -100; rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -20; ls scripts | rg 'spec|lore'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p' && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts && git commit -m \"Call onError for non-Error rejections\" && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
